candidates.name: Playwright Test
candidates.fit_for_gap: Real-browser functional certification of every stable React route against UAR and deterministic provider fixtures.

evidence.claim: Official guidance recommends user-facing locators and retrying web-first assertions.

risks: E2E suites become slow or flaky if used instead of lower-level store/page contracts.
candidates.decision_rationale: Already installed and used; expand it into a page capability matrix rather than adding another E2E framework.

candidates.name: React Testing Library and user-event
candidates.fit_for_gap: Page-level interaction and accessibility contracts at the React hook/component boundary.

evidence.claim: Tests are designed to resemble how users interact with the product rather than component internals.

risks: Can still over-mock stores/services and miss backend contract drift.
candidates.decision_rationale: Already installed; suitable for success/error/empty/loading page contracts without coupling to implementation details.

candidates.name: Mock Service Worker
candidates.fit_for_gap: Reusable HTTP/WebSocket success, failure, latency, and unhandled-request fixtures for Vitest page contracts.

evidence.claim: Vitest officially recommends MSW for network request mocking and supports failing on unhandled requests.
MSW provides client-agnostic request interception reusable in browser and Node contexts.

risks: New dependency must be version/security verified before adoption.
May duplicate deterministic real-server fixtures if applied indiscriminately.
candidates.decision_rationale: Pilot on one domain; adopt only if fixtures become reusable across service/store/page tests.

candidates.name: AG-UI core event model
candidates.fit_for_gap: Canonical lifecycle, text, tool, state snapshot/delta, raw, and custom event conformance for chat and Runtime Console.

evidence.claim: AG-UI is event-driven and transport-agnostic, with a typed frontend/agent execution interface.
The protocol defines lifecycle, message, tool, snapshot/delta, raw, custom, and reasoning event patterns.

risks: Direct SDK adoption could duplicate UAR's normalized event model.
candidates.decision_rationale: Use as the conformance authority; adopt the package only after a compatibility spike proves it removes duplication.

candidates.name: Google A2UI specification and catalogs
candidates.fit_for_gap: Versioned declarative UI contract and security model for UAR's React A2UI renderer and testing surface.

evidence.claim: A2UI v0.9.1 is the current production release; v1.0 is candidate; clients render declarative data through approved native components.
AG-UI explicitly treats A2UI as a separate generative UI specification that it can transport.

risks: No verified drop-in React renderer candidate was identified within the research cap.
candidates.decision_rationale: Build UAR's approved React catalog/renderer against one declared version; do not import HTMX assumptions.

candidates.name: Existing Zustand plus Prometheus entity graph
candidates.fit_for_gap: Single application-state boundary for domain actions, optimistic updates, realtime reconciliation, and React subscriptions.

evidence.claim: The repository already implements Zustand stores, entity graph adapters, optimistic helpers, PGlite, and SSE synchronization.

risks: Current dual state patterns and direct graph mutation permit ownership ambiguity.
Migration must avoid parallel v2 pages.
candidates.decision_rationale: Enforce and finish the existing architecture rather than adding Redux, React Query ownership, or an admin framework.

build_required.need: Feature-owned stores/hooks and automated React layer-boundary gates
build_required.why_no_candidate: This is repository-specific ownership and import policy; existing libraries cannot infer UAR domain boundaries.

build_required.need: Unified UAR normalized-event to AG-UI adapter and fixtures
build_required.why_no_candidate: UAR has a custom Rust normalized event model that must be mapped and certified, not replaced blindly.

build_required.need: Validated React A2UI renderer/catalog shared by Chat and A2UI Testing
build_required.why_no_candidate: No verified drop-in React renderer matching UAR's component system and trust boundary was found within the research cap.
The matrix must reflect UAR's exact routes, endpoints, maturity, and release gates.

build_required.need: Documentation truth gates and supersession strategy
build_required.why_no_candidate: The inconsistent claims are repository-specific and distributed across current and historical documents.
